scripts.dev: npm run build --prefix backend && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:deploy: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix backend && playwright test
